games.name: SURVIVE PURSUER (Die of Death)
games.desc:
Survive The Pursuer.

Version: v3.5

You didn’t exactly choose this place. Life just kind of dropped you here, and now you’re stuck in a forest that was never really yours. Something else lives here, and when night falls, it wakes up hungry. It hunts, it kills, and somehow it always knows where to look. So yeah, no pressure. Think you can survive the pursuer, or are you about to become part of the wildlife?

Can you survive the pursuer?
